# Merkava Flagship Revelation — Phase One

The Awtsmoos gives a battlefield form without surrendering unity to the form;
Awtsmoos.com should make the flagship readable outside and inside, where every finite class receives one clear responsibility.

## Evidence

Merkava is the only Awtsmoos Original explicitly badged `Flagship` in the canonical Originals catalog. It is therefore the first deep product target.

The codebase already has a strong modular foundation: app, game, render, input, persistence, routes, UI, audio, commerce, and configuration modules are almost entirely below 120 lines. The first wave must preserve that strength.

## Proven structural debts

1. CSS is not localized. `foundation.css`, `hud.css`, `mode.css`, `boss-hud.css`, `overlays.css`, `feedback.css`, `commander-sigil.css`, and `responsive.css` use bare selectors such as `:root`, `*`, `body`, `button`, `.hud`, `.panel`, `.overlay`, and `.notification`. Merkava shares the page with the global player shell, so these selectors can leak across surfaces.
2. Layering uses raw integers (`3`, `4`, `10`, `12`, `30`) instead of a named Merkava layer contract.
3. Button styling has no complete hover/active/focus-visible/reduced-motion system in the game-local CSS.
4. `MerkavaApp` passes `this.systems.state` as the second argument to `InputController`, then passes ability/pause callbacks as ignored extra constructor arguments. Current `InputController(canvas, actions)` expects `actions.ability()`, `actions.pause()`, `actions.reversed()`, `actions.getLane()`, and `actions.setLane()`. `GameState` does not provide that API.
5. `InputController` captures global `window` directly and cannot detach listeners because anonymous closures are registered.
6. `main.js` owns runtime errors, boot, diagnostics globals, optional commerce, and fatal UI directly; its helper functions have only file-level documentation.
7. `MerkavaApp` constructs nearly every dependency internally and queries the DOM directly, limiting testability and explicit API composition.
8. Many public methods lack method-level JSDoc even though the file architecture is already modular.

## Protected work

`games/Merkava/index.html` is already modified by another change stream. Do not rewrite it in this wave. Its module entry already contains `compact=true`, so no HTML edit is required for CompactJS.

## First-wave purpose

Make the flagship's boundaries explicit without altering campaign rules, save format, combat math, renderer behavior, or current diagnostic compatibility.

The first wave should localize CSS, formalize layers/interactions, repair input composition, create explicit runtime/bootstrap APIs, and add detailed per-method documentation to every rewritten JS file.
